thread:
Carla: RC-2026.03.23-1 created from commit 0a1b2c3. Pinning artifact inference-service:2026.03.23-rc1. Requesting eyeballs + ops vote for promo window 16:00-18:00 UTC. Canary at 10% for 20m. @Oncall Tim please ack. Release notes draft: https://stash.redwood/changes/rc-2026-03-23-1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: artifact verified (sha256 ok). smoke tests: PASS. kv-warm job queued. canary deploy scheduled 15:45 UTC.

Ben: quick Q — what's the rollback target if latency or errors spike? would like explicit rollback artifact and throttling plan.

Sarah: I'll monitor perf. I ran microbench on canary cluster vs baseline: p95 +3% for seq=512, throughput ok. Watching memory and GC.

Alice: approve from release side :+1:. Suggest flag-freeze during quiet window (no schema or DB changes). Also ensure runbook link in release notes.

Oncall Tim: @Carla ack. I'll be on standby 15:30-18:30 UTC. Pagerduty notification set. Abort criteria: errors > 1% OR p95 > 20% above baseline -> immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (10%) -> 15:47:22 UTC. Health check summary: 200/200 OK, 0 pod restarts, traces sampled. Logs: no obvious exceptions.

Carla: telemetry smoke looks clean so far. If stable we'll move to 50% in 10m. Note: adding DB feature-flag freeze tag to the PR. Release note bullet: "Updated batching heuristic; minor prompt formatting tweak."

ReleaseNotesBot: Release notes published -> https://redwood.in/releases/rc-2026-03-23-1. Highlights: improved batching heuristic, quantization-profile tweak. Known issue: very rare prompt-edgecase formatting.

Ben: prepared rollout-lift script and rollback playbook: /ops/playbooks/rc-2026-03-23-1.md. Rollback target: inference-service:2026.03.22-4. Throttle plan included.

Sarah: 50% check @ 15:59 UTC: p95 +3%, errors 0.03% — within thresholds. Memory stable. Recommend promote to prod at 16:10 UTC if no regressions.

Alice: :+1: promote. Reminder: kick off KV cache warmers across regions before full lift.

deploy-bot: Promotion to prod initiated -> 16:12:05 UTC. Traffic ramping: 50% -> 100% over 12 minutes. Canary monitors engaged.

Oncall Tim: watching dashboards. Abort condition repeated: if traffic drop > 10% or error spike exceeds 1% -> rollback to inference-service:2026.03.22-4.

Carla: Promotion complete at 16:24 UTC. Post-deploy sanity checks: all green. Closing RC-2026.03.23-1. Thanks team :tada:
